scope: Implement the two diagnostic stages in GPT_diagnosis_v4.md. Preserve V20's fitted-model certificate and V21's original results. The three repeated waiting states and archived dates are development data.
minimal_policy: Use V20's complete through menu, publish at root plus 30 seconds, board the first legally visible candidate and break simultaneous offers by scheduled remaining travel time and connection ID. Execute the same frozen tails. Only the candidate compiler uses the posterior.
fixed_menu_ablation: Compare first opportunity, same-menu compiled nominal, exact V20 and same-menu 2048-draw rollout on 128 new paired worlds per root. Report action disagreements and cold and reused-compiler cost separately. The new fitted worlds support attribution, not a new date validation or an inherited 60-second guarantee.
reachable_offers: Enumerate independent first-departure factors of the retained distinct through trips. Track all positive-probability first offer histories, including the clocks of early A/B departures, the published controller and its expiry. For policy divergences, integrate actual subsequent decisions and the shared conditional through tail. The reduced state is sufficient for the tested decisions and omits unrelated arrivals that the controllers do not consult. Floating point totals are descriptive model calculations.
resolution: Use a separately labeled legacy point law, then local integrated-clock grids of 60, 20 and 10 seconds for the same selected trips, with the V20 menu fixed. Keep physical time, fitted parameter units, model service mechanisms and the platform contract. Compare within the bounded ordered reference separately from legacy-to-integrated model sensitivity. Run the exact two-vehicle counterexample. Do not extend the grid if finer resolution leaves no substantial actionable gain.
natural_screen: Use existing development archives, a fixed schedule-only named-OD clock census and pre-outcome mechanism definitions. Count ordinary and near-critical cases, unknown outcomes and observed legal decision witnesses. Treat archive outcomes and fitted model expectations separately.
research_decision: Only develop a new OR method if both diagnostics identify a natural, actionable advantage over the first-opportunity and nominal policies with meaningful frequency and plausible net cost. Otherwise close the current precision-led branch and preserve the minimal application baseline, fitted results and negative findings. Do not treat a constructed example or a large hindsight gap as a passed gate.
